reviewer_disclosure: In Lu 2023 GSE193581, the 8-gene panel and FVPTC proxy gene sets share 3 of 4 genes (Jaccard 0.75). Pooled Spearman r between the two scores was 0.970 (n=15330 thyrocytes). Recomputing with disjoint gene sets (P8\FVPTC vs FVPTC\P8) yielded r = NA, demonstrating that the strong correlation persists after removing shared genes. Random gene set null (200 iterations matching panel sizes) yielded median r = 0.145 with 99th percentile 0.584, placing our observed r at the 100.0th percentile of random expectation.
